component: Composer3 and Android hardware AIDL generated headers

evidence.generator_comments: All 276 generated headers name one of these 92 source AIDL paths and use the checkout name hardware-interfaces-qpr2.
evidence.notice: The upstream project NOTICE at the pinned revision is the Apache-2.0 license text; its SHA-256 is recorded above.
evidence.pinned_manifest: manifests/android-graphics-candidates.json records the exact hardware/interfaces, build-tools, and AIDL source revisions above.
evidence.upstream_check: All 92 referenced files exist at the pinned hardware/interfaces revision and contain an Apache-2.0 license header.

limitation: The original generation run has no separate receipt recording source/tool commit IDs or the prebuilt aidl executable hash. Generator comments and the matching pinned candidate manifest establish source-path correspondence, but exact historical generation from these immutable inputs is not independently reproducible from the retained checkout.
